Hi! I'm Audrey, a BSIT graduate with an interest in *web development*, *UI/UX design*, and *graphic design*. I enjoy creating functional, user-friendly, and visually appealing digital experiences while exploring new tools and technologies. I'm always eager to learn, improve my skills, and take on new challenges where I can grow both personally and professionally.
